trackerManaged.description: True for a notebook order placed on the notebook order tracker; one placed before it keeps the approval flow.

orderNumber.description: SOP order number (<Item>-<School>-<YY-MM-DD>-<NNNN>); null for drafts and categories without an order code. Show it as the headline with "Ref <id>" beneath.

workflowStep.description: The order workflow's current step, for lists; null when the order has no workflow or none has reported yet

uploadedBy.description: User id of the uploader (catalog_order_assets.uploaded_by); null when no user is recorded

supersededBy.description: User id of whoever removed or replaced the file (catalog V39); null while current, and for removals recorded before V39

paged.description: Notebooks only: lines collect a printed-page count

notesEnabled.description: The order form collects a free-text note

orderCode.description: Item code in order numbers (^[A-Z]{2,4}$, unique); null means no order number

itemNoun.description: Noun used in the introduction message, e.g. "bill book"

workflowDefinition.description: Template new placements start; null means no order workflow. Needs orderCode.

OrderWorkflowStep.description: Stored in catalog_orders.attributes.workflowStep by the tracker status push (D5).

order.description: Current step order; for a completed workflow, the last step

label.description: Label of the line's main selection (size, type or product)

details.description: The line's other selection labels joined with " · "; null when there are none

OrderQuantities.description: D25: quantities from the school's order form, for every item.

other.description: Notebooks on lines that match no title-card size

notebooks.description: Notebooks in the order for this row

sheets.description: Print sheets needed: ceil(n/8)+13 (King+Jumbo King, Long) or ceil(n/4)+25 (Jumbo Long, FA); 0 when n is 0

TitleCards.description: D24: notebook title-card quantities computed from the placed lines.

rows.description: Always the four rows, in table order

unmatched.description: "Not on a title card" lines (for example Drawing books)

OrderWorkflowSummary.description: Header data for the order workflow screen, for every workflow category (superadmin and operators in scope).

itemCode.description: The category's order code (NB, FE, ...); null without one

schoolNotes.description: The school's order-form notes ("From the order form")

titleCards.description: Notebook orders only; null for other items

trackerPending.description: The workflow is queued but operations has not created it yet

CatalogOrderFormDetail.description: The order-form detail (GET /supply/orders/{id}/form); further keys are form-specific.

ProductCategoryRequest.description: Category create/update body (CatalogDefinitionRequests.Category). Superadmin with catalog builder permissions.

orderCode.description: ^[A-Z]{2,4}$, unique; null or blank clears it
